assertions.assertion: The denial carries reason code CO-197.
CPT 93229 corresponds to Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring.
A clinical indication note exists documenting the indication.
The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness.
Dizziness and giddiness is coded as R42.
The patient has a history of transient cerebral ischemic attacks.
Transient cerebral ischemic attacks are coded as G45.9.
The patient has known sick sinus syndrome.
Sick sinus syndrome is coded as I49.5.
Mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to correlate symptomatic events with potential arrhythmic activity or conduction abnormalities.
Such arrhythmic activity or conduction abnormalities may not be captured on standard ambulatory monitoring.
